pages.en:
518
S. I. D.
F. O. REG
No. 518
Date 17/8/16
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Hongkew Station.
August 16th 1916
REPORT ON J.B.A.Grote and the sale of arms.
Made by D. S. I. Reeves. Forwarded by Chief Detective Ins.
Sir,
I forward herewith the name of a German J.B.A.Grote, living at
21 Miller Road, as a man whose name should be on our records.
Yesterday evening this man was brought in drunk and incapable
and on him being searched the enclosed card and paper relating
to arms was found in his pocket. He was locked up all night
and on him being released sober this morning, I asked him what
his occupation was. He said he was a broker. I asked him if
he ever tried to sell arms, and he replied that he did not deal
in such goods. I did not show him the paper or did he ask for
it. Grote is a small man with grey hair and small grey
moustache, age 45 years, single. He speaks English very well.
He seems to be very poor, and he had no money on him when he was
brought in. The Chinese boarding house he is living in, caters
for the poorer class of foreigners, and I have known Germans to
stay there. These premises were searched by me for opium on
the 27th May 1916, but nothing was found.
Grote has been living at 21 Miller Road for the past 9
days and previous to that he stayed in the Savoy Hotel. I have
seen the Chinese proprietor of the boarding house, and he informs
me that Grote has informed him that Li Yu Hang and Dr Sun Yet Sun
are friends of his. He states that Grote has informed him that
he is going to pay a visit to Canton very soon. Grote can also
read and write Chinese. I think that probably the trip to
Canton will be to try and sell the arms. The proprietor will in-
form me when Grote thinks about going.
I am Sir,
Your obedient servant.
Percy. S. Reeves
D.S.I.

特别情报科 (S. I. D.)
外交部登记处 (F. O. REG)
编号 518
日期 1916年8月17日
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
虹口巡捕房。
1916年8月16日
关于 J.B.A.Grote 及武器销售事宜的报告。
由特别警探督察里夫斯 (D. S. I. Reeves) 呈报。经首席警探督察转呈。
阁下，
兹随函附上一名居住在密勒路21号 (21 Miller Road) 的德国人 J.B.A.Grote 的姓名，此人应列入我方档案记录。
昨晚，此人因醉酒且无行为能力被带至巡捕房，在对其搜身时，在其口袋中发现了随函附上的名片及与武器有关的文件。他被关押了一整夜，今晨待其酒醒释放后，我询问其职业。他称自己是经纪人。我问他是否曾试图出售武器，他回答说他不经营此类商品。我未向他出示该文件，他也未索要查看。Grote 身材矮小，头发灰白，留有灰色小胡子，年龄45岁，未婚。他的英语讲得很好。他似乎非常贫穷，被带来时身上分文未带。他所居住的中式寄宿公寓主要接待较贫困的外国人，我曾知晓有德国人入住此处。我曾于1916年5月27日搜查过该处所是否有鸦片，但一无所获。
Grote 在过去9天一直居住在密勒路21号，在此之前他住在萨伏伊酒店 (Savoy Hotel)。我会见了该寄宿公寓的中国业主，他告诉我，Grote 曾向他提及李煜堂 (Li Yu Hang) 和孙逸仙博士 (Dr Sun Yet Sun) 是他的朋友。他还称，Grote 告诉他不久将前往广州访问。Grote 还能读写中文。我认为此次广州之行很可能是为了尝试出售武器。一旦 Grote 有动身之意，该业主将通知我。
此致
敬礼
您的顺从仆人
珀西·S·里夫斯 (Percy. S. Reeves)
特别警探督察
